findings.mechanism: N+1 query pattern: each order is serialized in a loop, invoking serialize_order which likely issues a separate SELECT per order. This matches mechanism 06-finding-n-plus-1 from the reference material.
findings.remediation: Replace the per-order serialization with a bulk query that preloads all needed related data (e.g., join items in list_for_customer or modify serialize_order to accept preloaded data), eliminating the N+1 queries.
findings.arithmetic: queries = 1 (list_for_customer) + N (serialize_order per order). For N=100 orders, queries = 101, i.e., queries_per_request = N+1.
